name: modern-12
note: 12 puzzles for bench runs: 8 american, 4 cryptic. This is the standard bench set (T64): 8 2024 Los Angeles Times weekday dailies fetched from the xd corpus plus 4 Guardian cryptics. Puzzles are fetched locally on demand with `xw fetch` and are never committed to this repository (no-distribution policy) - only these ids are. See docs/benches/SETS.md for the exact, reproducible fetch recipe.
